column1: # The Noto faces of the fallback chain (09 section 3.2; EXP-026, EXP-047, EXP-037; owner decisions 228
# and 241; downloads approved on 2026-11-27 from github.com/notofonts only). fetch-noto.sh reads this
# file while the image is built. Every download is pinned by its SHA-256, every face and licence text
# by its own, and a mismatch stops the build. The order is the order of the fallback chain: the
# complex scripts first, then CJK, whose face also holds punctuation and Latin forms that must not
# shadow them. All faces are SIL Open Font License 1.1 and are used unmodified.
# Sizes (bytes): Arabic zip 18,777,381, face 271,652; Hebrew zip 3,734,185, face 66,156; Devanagari
# The CJK face is the full Japanese-region OpenType file of Noto Sans CJK: it also has the
# simplified and traditional Chinese characters and Hangul (checked with the converter's cmap reader).
# Columns, separated by tabs: name, version, url, SHA-256 of the download, member of the zip that is
# the face (- when the download is the face), face file name, SHA-256 of the face, licence, where
# the licence text is (a member of the zip, or a URL), SHA-256 of the licence text.
